skill_name: Construct an essay arguing in favour of using AI in school education.
workflow: AI has the potential to revolutionize school education and give students better learning opportunities. AI-driven technologies such as automated grading, virtual classrooms, personalized learning, and real-time feedback provide students with more engaging and supportive learning experiences. AI can also be used to generate customized curriculum for each student, helping them learn in a way that suits their individual needs better.
